verses.text: O Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known me.

segments.text: O Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known
me

verses.text: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising; Thou understandest my thought afar off.

segments.text: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising;
Thou understandest my thought afar off.

verses.text: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.

segments.text: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down,
And art acquainted with all my ways.

verses.text: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.

segments.text: For there is not a word in my tongue,
But, lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.

verses.text: Thou hast beset me behind and before, And laid thy hand upon me.

segments.text: Thou hast beset me behind and before,
And laid thy hand upon me.

verses.text: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; It is high, I cannot attain unto it.

segments.text: Such
knowledge is too wonderful for me;
It is high, I cannot attain unto it.

verses.text: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? Or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

segments.text: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit?
Or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

verses.text: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou art there.

segments.text: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there:
If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou art there.

verses.text: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

segments.text: If I take the wings of the morning,
And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

verses.text: Even there shall thy hand lead me, And thy right hand shall hold me.

segments.text: Even there shall thy hand lead me,
And thy right hand shall hold me.

verses.text: If I say, Surely the darkness shall overwhelm me, And the light about me shall be night;

segments.text: If I say, Surely the darkness shall overwhelm me,
And the light about me shall be night;

verses.text: Even the darkness hideth not from thee, But the night shineth as the day: The darkness and the light are both alike to thee.

segments.text: Even the darkness hideth not from thee,
But the night shineth as the day:
The darkness and the light are both alike
to thee

verses.text: For thou didst form my inward parts: Thou didst cover me in my mother’s womb.

segments.text: For thou didst form my inward parts:
Thou didst cover me in my mother’s womb.

verses.text: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Wonderful are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.

segments.text: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made:
Wonderful are thy works;
And that my soul knoweth right well.

verses.text: My frame was not hidden from thee, When I was made in secret, And curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

segments.text: My frame was not hidden from thee,
When I was made in secret,
And
curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

verses.text: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance; And in thy book they were all written, Even the days that were ordained for me, When as yet there was none of them.

segments.text: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance;
And in thy book they were all written,
Even
the days that were ordained
for me
When as yet there was none of them.

verses.text: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!

segments.text: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God!
How great is the sum of them!

verses.text: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: When I awake, I am still with thee.

segments.text: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand:
When I awake, I am still with thee.

verses.text: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: Depart from me therefore, ye bloodthirsty men.

segments.text: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God:
Depart from me therefore, ye bloodthirsty men.

verses.text: For they speak against thee wickedly, And thine enemies take thy name in vain.

segments.text: For they speak against thee wickedly,
And thine enemies take
thy name
in vain.

verses.text: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? And am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

segments.text: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee?
And am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

verses.text: I hate them with perfect hatred: They are become mine enemies.

segments.text: I hate them with perfect hatred:
They are become mine enemies.

verses.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts;

segments.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart:
Try me, and know my thoughts;

verses.text: And see if there be any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.

segments.text: And see if there be any wicked way in me,
And lead me in the way everlasting.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
